## Stone Coated Steel Metal Shingle Roofing
Source: https://versteraroofing.com/stone-coated-steel-metal-shingle-roofing.html

# Stone Coated Steel Roofing
Verstera Roofing specializes in building high-end Stone Coated Steel metal roofing systems designed to withstand hail and last 50–70 years.

## What is Stone Coated Steel Roofing?
Stone coated steel is a premium metal roofing material made from galvanized steel panels coated with natural stone granules. The outer layer shields the steel from UV rays, hail, and weathering while enhancing appearance. Designed to mimic traditional shingles, tiles, or shakes, it combines the strength and longevity of metal with the visual appeal of classic roofing styles, offering resistance to denting, fading, and corrosion.

Verstera's teams have extensive experience installing and maintaining metal shingle roofs throughout Killeen, Harker Heights, Temple, Belton, Georgetown, Round Rock, and Austin, TX, providing solutions built for the high-impact hailstorms of Central Texas. Metal roofing in general typically offers a 60–75 year lifespan.

## Metal Roofing Services
- New Metal Roof Installation
- Roof Replacement with Metal (conversion of existing asphalt, tile, or other roofing to metal shingle roofing)
- Metal Roof Repair (panel replacement, seam repair, flashing issues, leak points)
- Metal Roof Maintenance (inspections, fastener checks, sealant renewal)
- Storm Damage Repair (hail, wind, or falling debris, with insurance documentation)
- Weatherproofing & Coating

## Benefits of Metal Roofing
- Superior Longevity: typically 40–70 years, 2–3x longer than asphalt shingles
- Extreme Weather Resistance: engineered for winds up to 140+ mph
- Energy Efficiency: reflective properties may reduce cooling costs by 10–25% in summer
- Fire Resistance: non-combustible, Class A fire rating
- Environmental Benefits: 100% recyclable, high recycled content, typically no tear-off required
- Lightweight: significantly lighter than tile or slate
- Low Maintenance
- Impact Resistance: superior resistance to hail, branches, and debris
- Insurance Advantages: many insurers offer premium discounts for impact-resistant metal roofing
- Increased Home Value

## Installation Process
1. Initial Consultation
2. Property Assessment
3. Material Selection (type, profile, gauge, finish, color)
4. Detailed Proposal
5. Preparation (roof deck evaluation, underlayment)
6. Expert Installation
7. Ventilation & Accessories
8. Flashing & Details
9. Final Inspection
10. Warranty Issuance

## Sustainability
Most metal roofing contains at least 25% recycled content and is 100% recyclable at end of life. Reflective properties reduce heat-island effect and cooling demand. Metal roofing is compatible with rainwater collection and solar panel integration, and its long lifespan (4–5x conventional roofing) reduces replacement waste.

## Commercial Roofing
Source: https://versteraroofing.com/commercial-roofing.html

# Commercial Roofing Services in Central Texas
Comprehensive commercial roofing services designed to minimize business disruption while delivering durable, energy-efficient roofing for properties of all sizes — retail buildings, warehouses, office complexes, and industrial facilities.

## Services
- Commercial Roof Installation
- Commercial Roof Repair
- Roof Coating & Restoration
- Preventative Maintenance
- Emergency Roof Services (24/7 response)
- Roof Inspections & Assessments

## Commercial Roofing Systems Installed
- TPO Roofing (Thermoplastic Polyolefin): energy efficiency, UV resistance
- EPDM Roofing (rubber): weather resistance and longevity
- PVC Roofing: chemical resistance, suited to restaurants/industrial facilities
- Modified Bitumen: multi-layer, flexible and strong
- Built-Up Roofing (BUR): traditional multi-layer system
- Metal Roofing

## Commercial Roofing FAQs
- **Typical lifespan:** TPO/EPDM 20–30 years, metal 30–50 years, built-up roofing 15–20 years.
- **Signs of needed repair/replacement:** blisters or tears in membrane, standing water (ponding), interior water stains, rising energy bills, visible light through the deck. Twice-annual professional inspections recommended.
- **Business closure:** most commercial roofing work can be done while a business stays operational; crews coordinate with property managers and may schedule noisy work off-hours.
- **Energy-efficient options:** "cool roof" options like white TPO, PVC membranes, and reflective metal can reduce cooling costs 15–30% in summer.
- **Insurance claims:** Verstera documents storm damage, provides repair estimates, and works directly with adjusters.

## Storm & Hail Damage Repair
Source: https://versteraroofing.com/damage-repair.html

# Hail & Wind Damage Roof Repair Specialists
24/7 emergency response line: (512) 540-6388. Emergency tarping and temporary repairs provided to prevent further property damage.

## Common Types of Storm Damage
Hail damage (cracked shingles, dislodged granules, impact marks); wind damage (lifted/curled/torn shingles); missing shingles; damaged flashing; leaking roof; gutter damage.

## Storm Damage Repair Process
1. Emergency Response (tarping, temporary repairs)
2. Comprehensive Inspection (visible and hidden damage documentation)
3. Detailed Documentation (photos, measurements for insurance)
4. Insurance Assistance (working directly with adjusters)
5. Expert Repairs (matching materials)
6. Final Inspection

## Insurance Claim Support Includes
Free initial inspection; detailed documentation with photos/measurements; professional damage reports; direct adjuster communication; technical explanations; paperwork/claim filing assistance; settlement review.

## Storm-Resistant Roofing Options
Impact-resistant (Class 4) shingles; metal roofing (wind resistance up to 140 mph, 40–70 year lifespan); tile roofing; synthetic roofing.

## Coverage Area
Guadalupe County (Seguin, New Braunfels, Schertz, Cibolo, Marion); Bell County (Temple, Belton, Killeen, Harker Heights, Salado); Travis County (Austin, Pflugerville, Lakeway, Bee Cave, Manor); Bexar County (San Antonio, Live Oak, Universal City, Converse, Helotes); Williamson County (Round Rock, Georgetown, Cedar Park, Leander, Hutto); Comal County (New Braunfels, Bulverde, Garden Ridge, Spring Branch).

## Storm Damage FAQs
- **Signs of hail damage:** dented gutters/downspouts, damaged siding or window screens, missing granules, bruising/dimpling on shingles (some damage isn't visible from the ground).
- **Insurance coverage:** most policies cover sudden, accidental wind/hail/falling-object damage, depending on the specific policy and roof age.
- **Timeline:** emergency temporary repairs typically within 24–48 hours; permanent repairs 1–3 days for minor/moderate damage; full replacements generally 3–5 days once materials are on site.

## Roof Leak Repair
Source: https://versteraroofing.com/leak-repair.html

# Expert Roof Leak Repair Services
24/7 emergency response for active leaks. Emergency line: (512) 540-6388.

## Common Causes of Roof Leaks
Damaged shingles; flashing failures; clogged gutters; ice dams (rare in Central Texas); improper installation; age-related deterioration.

## Leak Repair Services
Emergency leak response; advanced leak detection (moisture meters, thermal imaging, water testing); shingle repair/replacement; flashing repair/installation; gutter maintenance/repair; ventilation improvements.

## Leak Detection Process
1. Visual Inspection
2. Moisture Detection (professional-grade meters)
3. Thermal Imaging (infrared cameras, when necessary)
4. Water Testing
5. Interior Assessment (attic, ceilings, walls)

## Signs of a Roof Leak
Water stains on ceilings; dripping water; musty odors; peeling paint or wallpaper; visible mold growth; damaged or missing shingles.

## Tile Roofs
Source: https://versteraroofing.com/tile-roofs.html

# Elegant Tile Roofing Solutions
Spanish, clay, and concrete tile roofing systems for distinctive homes throughout Central Texas.

## Types of Tile Offered
Spanish Tile (barrel-shaped, Mediterranean appearance); Clay Tile (fire-resistant, develops patina over time); Concrete Tile (versatile, cost-effective); Lightweight Tile Options (for homes that can't support standard tile weight).

## Tile Roofing Services
New Tile Roof Installation; Tile Roof Repair; Roof Conversion to Tile; Tile Roof Maintenance; Historical Tile Restoration; Storm Damage Repair.

## Benefits
Exceptional longevity (50–100 years properly installed); weather resistance; energy efficiency; Class A fire resistance; low maintenance (individual tile replacement); distinctive appearance; color retention; environmentally friendly/recyclable; pest resistance; sound insulation.

## Tile Roofing FAQs
- **Lifespan in Central Texas:** concrete tiles 50–75 years; clay/terracotta 75–100+ years.
- **Structural support:** most homes support concrete tiles; clay/terracotta may require reinforcement; lightweight alternatives available.
- **Energy efficiency:** natural thermal properties can reduce energy costs 20–30% versus asphalt shingles, especially with lighter colors.
- **Weather performance:** modern concrete/clay tiles tested to withstand winds up to 150 mph for many profiles; individual tiles can crack under large hail but can be replaced individually.
- **Cost:** typically 2–3x the cost of asphalt shingles upfront, often more economical over full lifecycle.

---

## Metal Roofs
Source: https://versteraroofing.com/metal-roofs.html

# Durable Metal Roofing Solutions
Standing seam and stone coated steel roofing systems designed for Central Texas weather.

## Types of Metal Roofing Offered
Standing Seam Metal (concealed fasteners, no exposed fasteners); Stone Coated Steel; Metal Shingles; Corrugated Metal; Metal Slate/Tile; R Panel Metal Roof.

## Metal Roofing FAQs
- **Lifespan:** 60–75 years typical, about 5x longer than asphalt shingles.
- **Noise:** properly installed metal roofing with solid decking, underlayment, and insulation is no louder than other materials in rain; may be somewhat louder in hail.
- **Severe weather performance:** rated for wind resistance up to 140+ mph; many systems carry Class 4 impact resistance, the highest rating available.
- **Cost:** typically 2–3x the cost of asphalt shingles upfront; often more economical over full lifecycle, potentially outlasting 5 asphalt replacements.
- **Installation over existing roof:** often possible depending on local codes and existing roof condition; standing seam typically requires tear-off, some metal shingle systems allow overlay.
- **Summer heat:** reflective metal roofing helps keep homes cooler and can reduce cooling costs 10–25%.

## Roofing FAQs (Central Texas)
Source: https://versteraroofing.com/blog-roofing-FAQs.html
Published: January 12, 2026

# Roofing in Central Texas: Most Common FAQs from Homeowners
Serving Austin, Round Rock, Georgetown, Leander, Harker Heights, Temple, and the surrounding Central Texas region.

## Storm Damage & Inspections
- **Detecting damage:** look for lifted/bruised/cracked shingles, granule loss, dents on metal, or leaks; most hail damage is hard to see from the ground, so a physical roof inspection is recommended. Verstera offers free, photo-documented inspections.
- **Timing after a storm:** inspect immediately — insurance companies allow only limited claim windows, and early documentation strengthens claims.
- **Inspection frequency:** every 2–3 years, and after every major hail or wind storm.

## Roofing Costs & Pricing
- **New roof cost in Texas:** asphalt shingle replacement typically $10,000–$25,000 for small-to-average homes (as of summer 2025); premium materials (metal, stone coated steel, tile) cost more. If covered by insurance, the homeowner's only out-of-pocket cost is the deductible.
- **Deductible payment:** required by Texas law (HB 2102); waiving/absorbing a deductible is illegal. Verstera provides proper paperwork (Certificate of Completion, RCV/ACV documentation) to keep claims compliant.
- **"Deductible waiving" offers:** illegal under Texas HB 2102 and often linked to fraudulent claims and poor workmanship.
- **Financing:** available with competitive rates; most homeowners receive same-day pre-qualification.

## Insurance Claims Process
- **Who to call first:** either an insurer or a roofer first is acceptable; the priority is working with people you trust and getting accurate documentation.
- **Claim timeline:** typically 7–14 days for an adjuster appointment, 1–3 weeks for approval; replacement can usually be scheduled within days of approval (subject to material availability).
- **Insurance rate impact:** storm claims are generally categorized as "Acts of God," and rate increases are based on regional storm history, not an individual homeowner's claim.
- **Adjuster meetings:** Verstera can meet the adjuster at the property to help ensure all damage is documented.

## Roofing Materials & Installation
- **Materials installed:** hail-resistant asphalt shingles, metal roofing, stone coated steel, tile roofing, synthetic underlayment, ice & water shield, ridge vents; brands include Owens Corning, TAMKO, GAF, Malarkey, and CertainTeed.
- **Installation time:** most asphalt-shingle residential roofs completed in one day; larger or specialty roofs (metal, tile, steep pitch) may take 2–3 days.
- **Repair vs. replacement:** repair addresses local issues; full replacement is needed when damage is widespread. Insurance typically covers full replacement when damage meets a threshold, often cited as 6–10 unique hail strikes per slope.

## Warranties & Protection
Manufacturer warranty (materials) and workmanship warranty (labor/installation) are both provided, in three tiers: 10-year, extended 15-year, and premium 30–50-year coverage depending on the system chosen. Additional third-party protection through Contractor Directorii includes a $30,000 deposit protection guarantee and a $250,000 workmanship/material guarantee.

## Choosing the Right Contractor
Look for: local presence (not storm chasers); membership in local community/Chamber of Commerce; Google, Facebook, BBB, and Yelp reviews; certification with major manufacturers; third-party backing (e.g., Contractor Verified, Contractor Directorii); proof of insurance; extended workmanship warranties.

## Roof Maintenance in Central Texas
Recommended at least once a year, ideally in early winter after leaves have fallen and before spring rains. Five annual tasks: (1) general shingle condition check for granule loss, nail pops, and hail/wind damage; (2) clear debris from the roof, especially valleys; (3) re-seal around all roof vents, accessories, and penetrations (roofing sealant tends to dry out and crack every 3–5 years in Central Texas heat); (4) seal over any exposed or rusty nail heads; (5) clean gutters at least once a year.

## Harker Heights, TX Service Area

# Roofing Services in Harker Heights, TX
Verstera Roofing was founded in Harker Heights, TX, and this community is where the company first built its reputation, serving areas around Fort Cavazos (Fort Hood). Homes here are frequently impacted by hail storms, high winds, extreme heat, and aging builder-grade roofing materials.

## Services for Harker Heights Homeowners
Residential Roofing; Roof Maintenance & Preventative Care; Leak Detection & Roof Repair; Storm & Hail Damage Inspections; Metal & Impact-Resistant Roofing (including stone-coated steel, Class 4 shingles); Roof Replacement Planning.

## San Antonio, TX Service Area
Source: https://versteraroofing.com/san-antonio-texas.html

# Roofing Services in San Antonio, TX
Verstera serves San Antonio and surrounding communities including Leon Valley, Stone Oak, Alamo Heights, Tobin Hill, Selma, Universal City, Cibolo, and Schertz. San Antonio homes face extreme heat, UV exposure, sudden windstorms, and seasonal hail. The area has a higher concentration of tile and stone-coated steel roofing systems than many other parts of Texas, requiring specialized installation and repair expertise.

## Services for San Antonio Homeowners
Residential Roofing; Roof Maintenance & Preventative Care; Leak Detection & Roof Repair; Storm & Wind Damage Inspections; Metal & Tile Roofing (including stone coated steel); Roof Replacement Planning.

# Verstera Roofing | Reviews & Testimonials
Based in Central Texas, Verstera Roofing specializes in durable, high-quality roofing including Class 4 impact-resistant shingles, stone-coated steel, and tile systems. The page aggregates 5-star reviews from Google, Facebook, BBB, and Yelp from clients across Georgetown, Austin, Killeen, San Antonio, and Schertz, generally citing professionalism, responsiveness, transparent insurance-claim assistance, and quality workmanship as recurring themes.
